MVHL.description: Moving Loads (MVHL). MVLD_CODE selects the design-code family and must match the model's Moving Load Code (MVCD); VEHICLE_LOAD_NUM=1 for a standard database vehicle (with VEHICLE_TYPE_NAME + STANDARD_CODE) or 2 for a user-defined load, and the matching VEH_* sub-object carries the code-specific parameters.

MVLD_CODE.description: Moving Load Code family (must equal the model's MVCD): 1=AASHTO Standard, 2=AASHTO LRFD, 3=China, 4=Taiwan, 5=Japan, 6=Korea, 7=India, 8=Canada, 9=PENDOT, 10=BS, 11=Eurocode, 12=Russia, 13=Korea LRFD 2011, 14=Australia, 15=Poland, 16=South Africa, 18=France.

VEHICLE_TYPE_NAME.description: Standard vehicle/type name (used when VEHICLE_LOAD_NUM=1), e.g. "H20-44", "HA", "Load Model 1".

STANDARD_CODE.description: Standard code (case-insensitive). Selects the code standard within the MVLD_CODE family.

USER_LOAD_TYPE.description: User-defined load type label (used when VEHICLE_LOAD_NUM=2), e.g. Truck/Lane, Train Load, Permit.

VEH_FR.description: [MVLD_CODE=18 FRANCE] France standard moving load parameters.

VEH_CN.description: [MVLD_CODE=3 CHINA] China moving-load parameters. Standard (VEHICLE_LOAD_NUM=1) uses CROWD_WIDTH/IMPACT_COEF/DD; user (=2) uses TRUCK_TYPE/TRAIN_TYPE-driven fields.

VEH_IN.description: [MVLD_CODE=7 INDIA] India moving-load parameters (IRC:6-2000 code 10, IRS Bridge Rules code 46).

PERMIT_LOAD.description: Permit / special vehicle definition (DTO_MVHL_PV). Used when VEHICLE_LOAD_NUM=2 and the load is a permit vehicle.

AXLE_TYPES.description: Axle-type groups of the permit vehicle.

items.description: Permit-vehicle axle group.

AXLE_TYPE.description: Axle type label referenced by PERMIT_LOADS entries.

EVENLY_DIST_LOAD.description: Treat the axle loads as evenly distributed.

POINT_ITEMS.description: Axle point loads for this axle type.

items.description: One axle point load: concentrated load and its longitudinal spacing.

POINT_DIST2.description: Secondary spacing (used only by some codes, e.g. KSCE-LSD15 second-track distance).
